label_interpretation: Gold labels remain the frozen native dataset annotations under the saved adapters; this calculation does not adjudicate alignment with the literal submitted-text semantic contract.
scope: Offline analysis of frozen public development samples; no model/network calls, no runtime changes, no held-out claims
score_source: Native raw_scores.contradiction (hosted) or nli_probabilities.contradiction (encoder); avoids normalization roundoff at exact policy/tie boundaries
threshold_selection: Unique native contradiction values descending, complete ties; best points selected on the same development labels, optimistic exploratory diagnostics
verification: Built-in complete-tie, 71-positive/3-versus-4-FP target-boundary, negative-pooling safety checks; every grouped sweep point cross-checked by direct classification; saved defaults and cross-model inputs checked
